newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline sharply firmer, barges lead market.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline sharply firmer, barges lead market.

text.p: NWE gasoline was sharply firmer on Tuesday as prices for benchmark eurograde barges rocketed by $9.
Premium unleaded barges traded at $220, $222 and $224 a tonne fob ARA. A regular unleaded barge traded at $213.
Traders said strong NYMEX unleaded gasoline futures and robust demand within the Rotterdam barge market were helping to underpin prices.
Cargo prices were notionally higher with barges, but trade was thin, with sellers sticking to the sidelines.
"They think the market is going to go higher and they're quite happy to build stocks," said one trader.
